_comment: SYNTHETIC fixture — assembled from public Spreed source, verified against real traffic spike-gate 2026-07-20. Represents incoming 'candidate' (trickle ICE) messages as delivered by the long-poll GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v3/signaling/{token}. Envelope shape identical to offer/answer; payload carries a single ICE candidate. WIRE-FORMAT (spike-gate, talk-main.js): payload.candidate is a NESTED OBJECT {candidate,sdpMLineIndex,sdpMid,usernameFragment} — NOT a flat string. Spreed's talk-main.js calls pc.addIceCandidate(a.payload.candidate), which requires RTCIceCandidateInit (object); a flat {candidate:"<str>"} yields TypeError ×N and breaks the peer pipeline (no audio sink). The earlier flat synthetic payload passed unit tests (compile-only) but was silently skipped on real traffic with 'json: cannot unmarshal object into Go struct field icePayload.candidate of type string' — see CLAUDE.md invariant on fixtures. Per pion/webrtc perfect-negotiation usage (spec §7), such candidates may arrive BEFORE the offer/answer; the call/peer layer must buffer them until SetRemoteDescription. Two records are shown: a 'host' candidate (TEST-NET-3 IP 203.0.113.10) and an 'srflx' candidate (TEST-NET-3 IP 198.51.100.20 from a STUN reflex); plus an end-of-candidates marker (payload.candidate.candidate === ""). Anonymized: sessionId -> 'SESSION_1'/'SESSION_2'; public ICE IPs -> RFC 5737 TEST-NET-1/2 (192.0.2.x / 198.51.100.x) and TEST-NET-3 (203.0.113.x); port numbers synthetic.
_outgoing_post_body_reference: Outgoing ICE candidate POST body form-encoded as {messages:'<stringified [{ev:"message", fn:"<stringified {type:"candidate",to:<peer>,roomType:"video",payload:{candidate:{candidate,sdpMLineIndex,sdpMid,usernameFragment}}}}>", sessionId:"<own_sessionId>"}]>'}. NOTE: payload.candidate is the same NESTED object as in this pull-response fixture (symmetric wire-format) — our outgoing candidate MUST be wrapped via signaling.WrapCandidatePayload, otherwise the remote Spreed client's addIceCandidate throws TypeError (bug #6).
